description: Header file for firmware update helper functions and constants, including logging, firmware states, file paths, and utility function declarations.

methods.name: eventManager
methods.description: Handles firmware update events based on event name and status.

methods.name: getDevicePropertyData
methods.description: Retrieves device property data given property name.

methods.name: isMediaClientDevice
methods.description: Checks if the device is a media client device.

methods.name: updateUpgradeFlag
methods.description: Updates the firmware upgrade flag based on protocol and action.

methods.name: extractField
methods.description: Extracts a specific field from a delimited string.

methods.name: updateFWDownloadStatus
methods.description: Updates the firmware download status structure.

methods.name: read_RFCProperty
methods.description: Reads a property value from RFC configuration.

methods.name: write_RFCProperty
methods.description: Writes a property value to RFC configuration.

methods.name: isMmgbleNotifyEnabled
methods.description: Checks if manageable notification is enabled.

methods.name: updateOPTOUTFile
methods.description: Updates the opt-out file for firmware updates.

methods.name: deviceSpecificRegexBin
methods.description: Returns device-specific regex for binary files.

methods.name: deviceSpecificRegexPath
methods.description: Returns device-specific regex for file paths.

methods.name: createDirectory
methods.description: Creates a directory at specified path.

methods.name: copyFileToDirectory
methods.description: Copies a file to a specified directory.

methods.name: FirmwareStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current firmware status and substatus.

methods.name: readProperty
methods.description: Reads a property from a file with delimiter.
